verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā magadhesu viharati maṇimālike cetiye maṇibhaddassa yakkhassa bhavane.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Magadhans at the Maṇimālika Shrine, the haunt of the native spirit Maṇibhadda.

verses.pali: Atha kho maṇibhaddo yakkho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then the native spirit Maṇibhadda went up to the Buddha, and spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
Each new day is better for the mindful,
and they are freed from enmity.”
Each new day is better for the mindful,
but they’re not freed from enmity.
But someone whose mind delights in harmlessness,
with love for all living creatures—
they have no enmity for anyone.”
